answer.summary: The frontend-quality step failed in the i18n checker, not in a test. It reports 5 missing or untranslated values in de, es and fr (e.g. 'Radial', 'Version v{version}', 'Relations') that match the English text. This is deterministic and tied to the change's new strings in the locale files, so a rerun will fail the same way. Fix by translating the values, or by adding legitimate loanwords to scripts/i18n-loanwords.json.
